MAJOR UPDATES FOR APPLE'S SOFTWARE PLATFORMS ARE NOW AVAILABLE
articles.summary: Apple has released its annual software wave across iOS 27, iPadOS 27, macOS 27, watchOS 27, visionOS 27, and tvOS 27. For IT teams, this officially starts the testing and deployment window, with device eligibility, Apple Intelligence and Siri AI availability, application compatibility, and managed-device behavior worth validating before broad rollout.

articles.title: GOOGLE SIMPLIFIES MICROSOFT 365 MIGRATIONS, BUT ENTERPRISE LIMITS REMAIN
articles.summary: Google Workspace now has a built-in setup workflow that can discover Microsoft users and migrate email, OneDrive files, calendars, contacts, and tasks. The catch: automated migrations currently support only 10 Microsoft users, so it is useful for small environments but does not replace enterprise migration tooling yet.

articles.title: GOLDIE CUTS THROUGH THE SALVATION ARMY'S IT MAZE
articles.summary: The Salvation Army is using an AI employee-support assistant inside Microsoft Teams to front multiple internal systems and help more than 10,000 personnel find answers without knowing which platform owns the information. The interesting lesson for IT is less about the chatbot and more about the underlying integration, ownership, guardrails, and service-design work required to make an AI support layer genuinely useful.

articles.title: GOVERN AI AGENTS LIKE WORKERS. JUST DON'T PRETEND THEY'RE HUMAN
articles.summary: As AI agents gain the ability to update records, issue refunds, communicate with customers, and operate across enterprise systems, organizations need clearer rules around what each agent can access and do. The argument: borrow useful concepts from workforce management—onboarding, scoped authority, supervision, and offboarding—but keep accountability with the humans granting that access.

articles.title: WHAT HAPPENS WHEN YOUR WORK AI CAN SEE MORE THAN IT SHOULD?
articles.summary:
For most tools, that's a risk. Leebry [11] is a Work AI platform built on RBAC, seeing what the person asking is allowed to see.

It resolves 30% of tickets, keeps a full audit trail, and loops in a person before anything risky happens.

AI AGENTS CAN USE QUILL TO TALK DIRECT TO ENTERPRISE SQL DATABASES
articles.summary: RavenDB has made its Quill software available to let AI agents query live enterprise SQL databases without data migration or a custom AI stack. Quill creates a synchronized context layer using change data capture that runs outside production and includes search, retrieval, and governance controls. Customers can launch production-ready agents in weeks for PostgreSQL, SQL Server, and MySQL deployments in the cloud or on-premises.

articles.title: DEVICIE MAKES APPLICATION MANAGEMENT AUTOMATIC WITHIN MICROSOFT INTUNE, MATCHING THE SPEED OF AI
articles.summary: Devicie is expanding its Intune automation to manage updates for more than 1,500 Windows and macOS applications, as well as customer line-of-business apps. Importantly, it operates inside the existing Microsoft stack and leaves deployment timing and update-ring control in Intune rather than introducing another endpoint-management console.

articles.title: TAKE CONTROL OF SNAPSHOTS
articles.summary: APFS Time Machine snapshots preserve storage blocks for rollback, which causes used space to grow as files change, requiring careful management. The process covers creating snapshots with tmutil commands, limiting their size by isolating large files on a separate APFS volume, deleting old snapshots in Disk Utility while keeping the latest, and rolling back the Data volume from Recovery.

articles.title: DATABRICKS CHANGES HOW WORKSPACE ACCESS IS GRANTED
articles.summary: Databricks is changing how workspace access is granted, with new users and service principals now requiring explicit entitlements instead of automatically inheriting access from the users system group. The change became mandatory on September 14, and organizations using Terraform, SCIM, or custom provisioning scripts may need to update their automation.

articles.title: MINOR ML UPGRADE: CLEARER OUTCOMES FOR TOOL CALLS - STANDARD RELEASE
articles.summary: Moveworks will now clearly tell users when an Agent Studio tool call fails or returns no results instead of potentially making an unsuccessful action look successful.

articles.title: YOU DON'T NEED TASK MANAGER, WINDOWS 11'S END TASK BUTTON KILLS APPS FROM THE TASKBAR, AND HERE'S HOW IT WORKS
articles.summary: Windows 11 has a lesser-known option that lets users kill frozen applications directly from the taskbar, a useful feature for IT teams looking to reduce a few basic support calls.
